description: List SpiderGate media-generation models (image / video / audio-TTS) and each model's declared `inputs` schema (the per-model tunables + their type/enum/min/max). ALWAYS call this and read a model's `inputs` BEFORE gate_media_generate — params the model does not declare are silently dropped server-side. Filter with `modality`.

include_inactive.description: Also return coming_soon/disabled models (not generatable yet).

modality.description: Filter to one modality: text-to-image | text-to-video | tts | stt | …

name: gate_media_models
